uncited: **3D Floating-Point Texture:** Stores the volumetric data.
The voxels are organized in a spherical coordinate system.
The 3D space is divided into $n$ layers along the altitude direction.
**Back Face Position Texture:** A 2D RGB texture used to store the termination points of rays entering the volume.
**Bounding Box Mesh:** A proxy mesh representing the volume bounds.
**Pre-computation of Volumetric Data:** The volumetric data is computed on the GPU using fragment shaders.
The power density $P$ at a point is calculated based on radio device parameters.
*   **Irregular Coordinates:** Spherical voxel coordinates are irregular, so standard regular volume rendering approaches fail.
*   **Performance:** Rendering performance declines easily with either decrement of viewing distance or increment of vertical scaling when the viewing distance is large.
